item.description:

👤 Paul Karlsson, Joel Davidsson, Rickard Armiento
arXiv:2609.14846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-throughput calculations using density-functional theory (DFT) are commonly used to explore point defects for applications in power electronics and quantum technologies. There is currently a major shift away from these traditional simulation techniques towards machine learning (ML) methods. We explore a class of physics-guided ML models for predicting defect formation energies and zero-phonon lines (ZPL) to identify point defects for quantum applications. The models are specifically targeted for use in a prescreening step for accelerated high-throughput workflows, and are therefore designed to avoid the costly relaxation step typically present with ML interatomic potentials (MLIPs). item.title: Bayesian neural networks versus deep ensembles for uncertainty quantification in machine learning interatomic potentials
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Riccardo Farris, Emanuele Telari, Nongnuch Artrith, Konstantin M Neyman, Albert Bruix
Neural-network-based machine learning interatomic potentials have emerged as powerful tools for predicting atomic energies and forces, enabling accurate and efficient simulations in atomistic modeling. A key limitation of traditional deep learning approaches, however, is their inability to provide reliable estimates of predictive uncertainty. Such uncertainty quantification is critical for assessing model reliability, especially in materials science, where often the model is applied on out-of-distribution data. Different strategies have been proposed to address this challenge, with deep ensembles (DE) and Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) being among the most widely used. item.title: Adaptive neural quantum states: a recurrent neural network perspective
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Jake McNaughton, Mohamed Hibat-Allah
Neural-network quantum states (NQS) are powerful neural-network ansätzes that have emerged as promising tools for studying quantum many-body physics through the lens of the variational principle. These architectures are known to be systematically improvable by increasing the number of parameters. Here we demonstrate an Adaptive scheme to optimize NQSs, through the example of recurrent neural networks (RNNs), using a fraction of the computation cost while reducing training fluctuations and improving the quality of variational calculations targeting ground states of prototypical models in one- and two-spatial dimensions. item.title: 利用图神经网络自动为CO₂同位素体分配AFGL量子数
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Marco G. Barnfield, Sergei N. Yurchenko, Jonathan Tennyson
准确分配计算分子能级的量子数，是生成用于辐射传输应用的完整谱线表及其线展宽参数的关键瓶颈。本文建立了自动化流程，利用GraphSAGE图神经网络、同位素体间微扰链和同位素体内转动阶梯边，为12种稳定CO₂同位素体中低于15000 cm⁻¹的转振能级分配AFGL量子数。该流程还结合匈牙利算法进行物理唯一性约束，并通过自举训练扩大覆盖范围，成功为大量未标注能级完成分配，同时提出了非对称同位素体中AFGL符号向Herzberg符号转换的方法。

item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Haoran Zhang, Zian Mao, Shufen Chu, Xiaoya He, Yuyan Guan, Antong Yang 等9位作者
异质界面决定着功能材料的性能与退化过程，但结构异质性、物相重叠和局域无序会使衍射信号高度复杂。本文提出物理信息神经网络框架Multi4D，结合物理约束的扩散变换器和旋转不变卷积神经网络，实现基于4D-STEM的自动多组分晶体学识别。该方法能够以98.82%的准确率生成确定性的晶体学图谱，并通过分类器预测不确定性构建衍射推断结构复杂度指标，应用于多类复杂界面，实现单纳米级结构解析。

👤 Aqsa Shaikh, Lubos Mitas, P. Ganesh, Jaron T. Krogel

item.title: Deep potential modeling of oxygen adsorption and surface reconstruction on silica
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
The binding energy of atomic oxygen on silica has remained uncertain for decades. This quantity directly governs catalytic heating during atmospheric re-entry. Classical potentials overestimate it by an order of magnitude (ReaxFFSiOGSI: ∼31 eV vs experiment: ∼3 eV), while first-principles methods cannot reach the scales required for adsorption equilibration. Although neural network potentials bridge this accuracy–efficiency gap, conventional sampling fails to provide training data spanning rare reactive events within collective phase transitions. Here, we train a neural-network potential (HyGSI) using a hybrid enhanced sampling-machine learning framework coupling on-the-fly probability enhanced sampling with deep potential molecular dynamics. HyGSI covers SiO 2 melting, pressure-dependent…

item.description:

👤 Rahma H. Thabet
CO₂ adsorption performance depends jointly on intrinsic material properties and experimental operating conditions, complicating adsorbent comparisons across the literature. Here, a curated database of 398 CO₂ adsorption measurements spanning four adsorbent categories, carbon-based, organic porous, inorganic porous, and metal oxide adsorbents, was analyzed using exploratory data analysis and explainable machine learning to identify the key descriptors controlling adsorption capacity. BET surface area, pore volume, temperature, CO₂ partial pressure, and adsorbent family were identified as the most informative predictors. 内聚区模型广泛用于描述断裂和界面失效，但传统模型通常依赖针对具体问题设定的解析牵引—分离关系以及现象学卸载和再加载规则。本文在广义标准材料框架内提出统一的可学习内聚模型，在保持热力学结构固定的同时学习本构函数。通过输入凸神经网络表示主动表面自由能、用单调神经网络表示损伤抗力的倒数，并将凸性、单调性和损伤不可逆性直接纳入本构表示，该方法能够描述多种复杂的内聚响应。

本文研究了对角Born-Oppenheimer修正（DBOC）对强磁场中轻质双原子分子电子结构的影响，考察对象包括H₂、HeH⁺和LiH，并采用Hartree-Fock与CISD方法。磁场强度最高达到0.2原子单位，覆盖磁性白矮星附近的天体物理条件。结果表明，DBOC会明显改变总电子能量，但其随核间距平滑变化且对磁场依赖较弱，因此主要表现为振动跃迁频率中近似与磁场无关的偏移；电子相关对DBOC的影响在强离子性LiH键中最为明显。

item.title: 磁性与非磁性胶体中的玻璃态特征与动力学阻滞
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Anuj Kumar Singh, Lambert Münster, Martin Weigel, Varsha Banerjee
本文比较低温下单分散磁性和非磁性软球流体的多种玻璃态指标，以研究磁矩的影响。分子动力学模拟表明，非磁性Lennard-Jones流体形成紧密聚集体，而偶极相互作用促进形成分支状、开放的形貌。两种流体的自 van Hove函数均表现出非高斯行为，反映出动态非均匀性和玻璃态特征；其中Stockmayer流体具有更重的尾部，这与链状结构中的强关联运动有关。
